evidence.quote: Analysts expect Nvidia to generate roughly $91 billion in revenue for the second quarter of fiscal 2027
evidence.one_line: Analysts expect Nvidia revenue of roughly $91 billion for fiscal Q2 2027 (quarter ending about July 2026), per the author's reporting of analyst expectations.
evidence.speaker: Analysts (unnamed, reported by author)

evidence.quote: Nvidia is deepening its sovereign AI strategy with a $1 billion investment in South Korea's Naver.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia agreed to invest $1 billion in South Korea's Naver to support sovereign AI infrastructure via the GAK Sejong data center.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia (as reported by equiti.com)

evidence.quote: A new collaboration with SK Group strengthens Nvidia's long-term AI memory supply chain through 2027.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia announced a new collaboration with SK Group securing long-term AI memory supply through 2027.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia (as reported by equiti.com)

evidence.quote: Partnerships involving companies such as Toyota, Fanuc and Kioxia illustrate that shift.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia has partnerships involving Toyota, Fanuc and Kioxia extending AI into industrial and manufacturing uses.
evidence.speaker: equiti.com author (Yazeed Abu Summaqa)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia's total revenue for fiscal 2027 (February 2026 to January 2027) reach the stated ranges in its FY2027 annual report?
